{{Quote|We had one of the bomb conspirators in our grasp today, but before I managed to question her, she was poisoned. She was under guard the entire time. I don't see how an assassin was able to get to her so quickly.|Ta'a Chume|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], a '''conspirator''' was involved in the [[Bombing of Fountain Palace|bombing]] of the dining hall of the [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]]'s royal residence, [[Fountain Palace]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]]. The [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] was intended to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarch]] of Hapes, [[Ta'a Chume]], and her granddaughter [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]]. After sending Tenel Ka to safety, Ta'a Chume headed up the investigation of the bombing and eventually caught the conspirator. However, before Ta'a Chume could question her, the criminal was [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] by an [[Unidentified assassin (Hapes)|assassin]] while she was under guard.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bomb conspirator was mentioned in the young readers novel ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'' by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]], which was published in [[1996]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />
